paper.title: Negative Chemotaxis of E. coli Exposed to Penicillin-Streptomycin Gradient in Well Plate Assay

gates.prompt: Mix prepared PenStrep aqueous dilutions 1:1 (50% v/v) with molten 8% LB agar maintained at 80°C in plastic vials, and dispense 200 µL of the mixture into the 12-well plate wells at an angle for directional solidification.
After PenStrep-agar solidification, overlay 200 µL of diluted E. coli culture into each well for real-time microscopy or Tecan OD600 measurement.

off_deck: autoclave LB broth media (20 g/L) at 121°C for 20 min
culture E. coli overnight at 37°C, 150 rpm
dilute overnight culture (500 µL in 15 mL LB media)
prepare 8% agar in LB media and store at 80°C
mix PenStrep dilutions 50% v/v with molten agar off-deck
pour/solidify agar mixture in 12-well plate wells
OD600 measurement using Tecan Infinite M200 plate reader
open_clarifications: The target cell density for diluting the overnight E. coli culture (500 µL into 15 mL media) is omitted in the paper text ('reduce the cell density to ** determined by **').
PenStrep concentration is stated as 15% and 25% dilutions of a 10,000 U/mL stock solution; volume fraction (v/v) relative to stock was interpreted as 0.15 and 0.25.
Total volume for intermediate aqueous PenStrep dilution prep prior to mixing 1:1 with agar was not explicitly stated; 200 µL total volume per well was selected for robot execution.
